law: REGISTRATION of E-Q21 — the embedding round (ORCH-R23 lane T14-a): the systemone typed question map used as an EMBEDDING FUNCTION. A fixed battery of K=8 score probes over N=20 sealed records yields an 8-dim vector per record; the vectors live in Cloudflare Vectorize (index qthe-jev-embed, cosine); retrieval is scored against sealed family labels. Committed BEFORE ANY EMBED CALL; corpus, probes, families, floors and verdict rules frozen here.
provenance_of_the_question: Operator dispatch ('you have vectorization and embedding and rapid calls… try things you haven't tried and you don't think anyone really has'). The typesafe playground register (docs/research/TYPESAFE-PLAYGROUND.md) holds batching/wobble/grounding findings but NO embedding use of the question map. Cloudflare Vectorize already carries qthe-twins (C6) and qthe-c6 — the account's third index is free tier. The harmony-r22 finding (families misread different statements) motivates C15: do embedding spaces diverge the way answers do?

design_frozen.corpus: N=20 records, 4 families x 5, drawn verbatim from the sealed verdict record (CLAIM-VERDICTS.md + the experiment verdict files). FAMILIES: N = the non-local channel (C2/E-Q1 wormhole LIVES, C6 twin sidecar DIES-r17, C9 hierarchical wormholes DIES, E-Q6 slot semantics, E-Q8 same-slot collisions); P = the local rule's physics (C1 timbre LIVES, C3 sigma DIES-null, C4 phase threshold DIES, E-Q7 checkerboard cascade, E-Q16 measurement wave); Q = quantum & provenance (C11 construction blindfold DIES, E-Q17 provenance at scale, E-Q20 comet root + interference, E-Q20b burn-in plateau); A = allocation & economics (C10 docket DIES-on-H1, E-Q19 tiled arbitration, E-Q18 population axis, E-Q15 reweighting null, T4-a batching economics 12.36x). Each record: id, family, text (<=120 words: the claim/experiment, the verdict, the decisive numbers). Sealed as corpus.json BEFORE any call.
design_frozen.probes: K=8 score questions, IDENTICAL for every record, each on the 5-level rubric ['zero','low','moderate','high','central'] (answer score 0-4, normalized /4 to [0,1]): P1 nonlocal-coupling; P2 local-rule physics; P3 quantum-or-randomness provenance; P4 allocation-or-arbitration; P5 repair-or-self-maintenance; P6 refuted-or-null outcome; P7 cost-or-performance economics; P8 exactness-or-determinism. One systemone call PER RECORD (batched 8 questions — the T5-a law, explicit aggregation loop). Model: jev-latest. The vector = [P1..P8]/4.
design_frozen.groq_cross: the same 8 probes through BOTH Groq seats (qwen3.8-27b, gpt-oss-20b) via the Actions seat, same rubric, one call per record per seat (max_completion_tokens: qwen 2048 / gpt-oss 6144 — the reasoning-budget law), for C15.
design_frozen.floors: F1 corpus+labels sealed before any call (this file + corpus.json sha-frozen); F2 all 20 typesafe rows http 200 with all 8 answers present (a refusal or missing axis VOIDS the axis LOUD); F3 vectors in [0,1]^8 exactly as derived (recompute check); F4 the Vectorize index exists and every upsert+query round-trips live; F5 repeat-stability: 3 records re-embedded once; per-axis |delta| reported AS-SAID with the r12 wobble law in mind (tolerance 0.25 registered, breach = honest finding not VOID); F6 the BOW control computed from the SAME record texts in code (tf-idf-free bag-of-words cosine, 1-gram, lowercase, no stoplist — the leanest honest baseline).

hypotheses.H1_C14: jev top-1 NN family accuracy (excluding self) > the majority-class baseline (5/20 = 25%) AND > the permutation-null expectation, on the Vectorize cosine ranking.
hypotheses.H2_C14: jev accuracy >= BOW-cosine accuracy minus 0 (the 8 interpretable axes match full-vocab BOW on this corpus). If BELOW BOW: C14's value claim narrows to dimensionality+interpretability, receipted honestly.
hypotheses.H3_C15: both Groq seats' retrieval accuracies are within one family-error (>= jev accuracy - 1/20) of jev's; AND the per-axis mean |jev - groq| divergence profile is structured (non-uniform across axes), the harmony finding extended to embeddings.
hypotheses.honest_null: if jev accuracy <= majority baseline: C14 DIES — the question map is an instrument panel, not an embedding; the record receipts it either way.

design_frozen.verdict_rules: accuracy = (# records whose top-1 non-self Vectorize neighbor shares the family) / 20. Permutation null = mean accuracy over 1000 random label permutations. BOW baseline = same top-1 rule over BOW cosine (computed in code, no LLM). C14 = H1 (AND F1-F4). C15 = H3's accuracy clause AND divergence clause. E vals: pairwise cosine histogram reported AS-SAID (no pass/fail).

falsifier: ANY of: F1 breach (corpus edited after calls); F2 incomplete rows without a LOUD receipt; F3 vector derivation mismatch on recompute; F4 index absent or query failure; a checkpoint written before its floor passes; the majority-baseline comparison computed on anything but the sealed labels.

predictions.P1: jev top-1 accuracy lands in [0.55, 0.80] — families are lexically distinct enough that a good reader groups them, but the A-family (economics) bleeds into others
predictions.P2: BOW-cosine accuracy >= jev accuracy (the family words — wormhole/quantum/docket/price — make BOW strong on THIS corpus; the honest expectation, and the reason H2 is registered as a real test)
predictions.P3: the Groq seats land within one family-error of jev (H3 accuracy clause LIVES)
predictions.P4: per-axis divergence is structured: the quantum axis (P3) and the null-outcome axis (P6) diverge most (the same axes the harmony battery found slippery)
predictions.P5: repeat-stability: >= 20 of 24 re-embedded axes within 0.25 (the wobble is answer-layer, scores should be calmer than choices)
predictions.P6: the N family (non-local channel) is the tightest cluster (its records share the most distinctive mechanism vocabulary)
